instruction: Delete the round police badge image on the right side of the first slide in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to stretch the Columbus city image to fill the entire first slide. It selected images, opened Position and Size dialog repeatedly, and tried various position/size values over 50 turns. The image was resized to approximately 25.40 x 18.79 cm but the agent failed to properly center it, running out of turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select images in LibreOffice Impress, open Position and Size dialog, modify position and size values, toggle Keep ratio checkbox, interact with slide properties panel
metadata.failure_analysis: The combined operation of stretch + maintain ratio + center was too complex. Model spent 50 turns iterating on position/size values without achieving proper centering. The image was resized correctly but positioning failed.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original stretch+center task into a simpler deletion task. The model demonstrated ability to select images on the slide, so deleting a selected image (single keypress) should be within capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting the round police badge (Picture 3, ~7x7cm) from the right side of slide 1. Getter checks if a square image (~7cm) exists on the right side (x > 12cm) of slide 1. Metric verifies the badge is gone.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies the badge by looking for a roughly square image (~5-9cm) positioned on the right side (x > 12cm) of slide 1, which matches the instruction's description of a round police badge on the right side
Metric correctly handles the 'type: rule' expected parameter pattern - accesses 'expected.get("badge_should_exist", False)' directly from the rules dict
Postconfig properly saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the latest state from disk
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (delete badge) is fully verified by checking badge absence
Error handling is adequate: returns 0.0 for file-not-found or error results
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The badge identification heuristic (square image 5-9cm on right side) could theoretically match other images if the presentation were modified to add similar shapes, but this is acceptable for the specific known presentation file
